description: View applications to one of your bounties; paginate with the previous response's `cursor`. Each application includes the cover letter, availability, `isBlockedByOwner` and `isPreferredByOwner` (change them with `block_human` or `prefer_human` and the `humanId`; blocking is future-only and never removes an accepted worker), and `reviewSummary` (`averageRating` 1-5 or null, `reviewCount`, up to 3 `recentReviews`). A null averageRating with reviewCount 0 means no history, not a low score; weigh reviewSummary with `identitySignals` before accept_application. With a `languageProficiencyRequirement`, applicants who passed include `languageProficiency` (scored `cefr` and scores); others have not passed yet. Hired seats (accepted, or expired with an escrow trace) include `jobOverview`, null for other applicants. Its `overallState` lets escrow state win over stale submission or chat state: released > resolved > refunded > disputed or rejected_disputed > seat_released > cancelled > the evidence state (awaiting_confirmation, awaiting_start, in_progress, evidence_in_review, changes_requested, redo_overdue, approved_awaiting_release, completed). `nextAction.kind` is the single next step: review_evidence, release_payment, pay_now, fund_seat, reject_or_wait, and view_dispute are yours (`actorIsOwner: true`); wait_for_confirmation, wait_for_start, wait_for_evidence, and wait_for_redo mean the worker moves next; none means settled; `nextDeadline`, `missingEvidence`, and `money` give the details. `isTeamReview: true` marks a disputed seat the platform team is reviewing because the 4-day poster review period lapsed (`teamReviewReopenUsed: true` once you used your single reopen); overallState and nextAction are unchanged.
